scope: OpenAI Responses API remote-MCP tool selection against the dnd-srd-oracle MCP server
pendingReason: A 2026-08-24 host execution attempt authenticated successfully against the OpenAI API (GET /v1/models returned 200) but every /v1/responses request was rejected: {"error":{"message":"You have no credits remaining. Add credits to continue using the API at https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing/.","type":"insufficient_quota","param":null,"code":"credit_balance_exhausted"}}. The rejection is a billing state on the operator's OpenAI project, not a demonstrated incapability of the Responses API remote-MCP surface, so no case was substituted from another product surface. CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY authorizes Secure MCP Tunnel control-plane operations only and is not an OpenAI API credential.

operatorProtocol.instructions: Reach the dnd-srd-oracle MCP server from the OpenAI Responses API with an OPENAI_API_KEY, either through a public HTTPS streamable `/mcp` endpoint or the Secure MCP Tunnel runtime. Send each mcpToolSelection prompt from the evaluation inventory as its own request, chaining a follow-up case with previous_response_id. Record the model, response identifier, advertised MCP server and tool metadata, the selected tool with its arguments and result or structured error, or the confirmed absence of a tool call, and the approval/confirmation behavior. Do not use a browser for this step and do not record these observations as installed ChatGPT evidence.
